    Aspose.Cells FOSS for .NET Documentation

    This directory contains the DocFX-based documentation source and generation tooling for Aspose.Cells FOSS for .NET.

    Overview

    The documentation pipeline builds a local HTML site and API reference from the library's XML comments plus Markdown guides in this folder. On Windows, the same source can also be compiled into a CHM help file.

    docfx is expected to be available as a .NET global tool.

    Quick Start

    Generate the local HTML site

    dotnet build ..\src\Aspose.Cells_FOSS\Aspose.Cells_FOSS.csproj
cd documentation
dotnet run -- --metadata

    Serve the generated site locally

    cd documentation
dotnet run -- --serve

    Then open http://localhost:8080.

    Generate a CHM file on Windows

    cd documentation
.\GenerateChm.ps1

    Files

    documentation/
|-- Aspose.Cells_FOSS.Documentation.csproj   # Documentation helper project
|-- Program.cs                               # DocFX wrapper entry point
|-- DocumentationValidator.cs                # Environment validation
|-- docfx.json                               # DocFX configuration
|-- toc.yml                                  # Site navigation
|-- index.md                                 # Documentation landing page
|-- QUICKSTART.md                            # Short getting-started guide
|-- USER_GUIDE.md                            # End-user overview
|-- README.md                                # This file
|-- api/                                     # Generated metadata
`-- _site/                                   # Generated HTML site

    Common Tasks

    Update the landing page

    Edit documentation/index.md.

    Update navigation

    Edit documentation/toc.yml.

    Improve API docs

    Add or update XML comments in src/Aspose.Cells_FOSS.

    Validate the documentation toolchain

    cd documentation
dotnet run -- validate

    Troubleshooting

    docfx not found

    Install the global tool:

    dotnet tool install -g docfx

    XML documentation missing

    Build the main project first so the XML documentation files are generated.

    CHM generation fails

    Install HTML Help Workshop from Microsoft and ensure its tools are available to the script.

    Generated site looks stale

    Delete documentation/api and documentation/_site, then regenerate.
